evidence: Modifies .github/workflows/ci.yml and multiple ci/test/* scripts to replace cross-compile jobs with native compile and test execution in BSD VMs.
rationale: Expanding CI to run tests on BSD platforms helps catch platform-specific regressions before they reach master. The author notes that without PR test runs, BSD regressions frequently slip into master and require reactive fixes, though concerns about nested VM brittleness on main CI workflows keep this at P3.
